Ursula Klein is a reliable and collaborative Tech Lead at Verve Commerce. She’s the kind of teammate who shows up with clear ideas and follows through without needing constant oversight.  

Ursula recently redesigned a monolithic microservice into modular components, which reduced deployment friction and made on-call support easier. She’s also been instrumental in aligning our cloud infrastructure with cost targets, balancing scalability needs without overspending. Her approach to system design feels intuitive—she’ll prototype solutions quickly and iterate based on real-world feedback.  

In Scrum, she owns sprint goals with a mix of pragmatism and creativity. Last quarter, she led a cross-team effort to refactor a legacy API, which cut integration delays by weeks. She’s great at translating technical constraints into stakeholder-friendly narratives, whether negotiating with product owners or explaining trade-offs to non-tech managers. When she mentors juniors, she doesn’t just teach code—she models how to approach problems with curiosity and patience.  

Ursula’s strength lies in her ability to bridge technical and operational priorities. She’s not just a good engineer—she’s a teammate who makes the team better. If you’re looking for someone who delivers reliably and thinks critically under pressure, she’s a solid choice.
